verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API whose root links to all resources, plus an account-export endpoint, so data can be pulled programmatically. Transactional webhooks stream open/click/bounce events, and the UI tracking reports cover open and click rates. None of the evidence shows a campaign-reports or automation/flow-metrics API endpoint. missing for 10: an explicit campaign reports API endpoint, flow/automation performance metrics via API, warehouse/BI connector documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
